text:
US enterprise software company | Full-stack Developer | Remote LATAM | $3.5k–$4.9k/mo

Hiring a long-term remote Full-stack Developer for a legacy enterprise web app.

Remote from: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Paraguay, Chile, Peru, or Costa Rica.

Stack: C#, .NET Framework 4.8, ASP.NET WebForms, ASP.NET MVC/Razor, Vue 2, Axios, SCSS, SQL Server/T-SQL, IIS.

Must have: 3+ years software experience, strong C#/.NET Framework, WebForms, MVC, Vue 2, SQL Server stored procedures/query tuning, debugging skills, C1 English.

This is not .NET Core. The codebase is classic .NET Framework/WebForms/MVC with SQL Server-heavy backend work.

Long-term contract, 40h/week.

If interested, apply here :
